title: Rachel G NDE 7555
content: Everything has a reason as to why things happen. On December 2, 2015, it is going to be seven years since my incident occurred. It has changed my life and the way I view things. On Tuesday, December 2, 2008, exactly around 4:30-5:00 pm that evening, my mom and I went to a restaurant to have a bite to eat before she dropped me off for my evening classes. I remembered telling her earlier that I was feeling unwell. We got our meal and I ordered a club soda to settle my stomach. After eating, I drank the club soda. On my second intake, I let out a loud burp and after that I lost focus of my mom and everything went dark. I was unaware of what was occurring around me, since I was transported to a different world. It seems that I was travelling to a destination in a car. I had no idea who was driving since I wasn't allowed to turn around. It was as if some force was keeping me from seeing who was next to me. I remember it as if it was yesterday. I was looking out the window and enjoying the view of vivid colors. The trees were of different colors and the grass was a shade of green I am not accustom seeing on earth. Everything around me appeared to be really bright, but not hot. It was a beautiful day. I remember holding out my hands in front of me which appeared to have a glow, like a halo surrounding me. I started to panic because I was in a strange place and everything seemed unreal. I could feel three beings sitting in the back seat with me. The strange thing about it, I never felt threatened by them or that they were any form of evil. I felt goodness coming from them. One of them spoke to calm me down, 'Don't worry, everything is going to be all right. Sit back and relax and enjoy the ride,' were the comforting words that were spoken to me. As soon as she said that, I felt as if a weight was lifted off me. It was like nothing mattered anymore, no more worries, and I felt totally at peace. I felt as if all the shackles fell off that kept me bonded to earth. I felt light as a feather, floating freely and being totally happy. The scenery was like in a painting. I awoke with a pastor's hands on my forehead saying prayers and my mom looking worried. I got medical attention afterwards. When I awoke, I felt refreshed and full of life. To this day I search for answers and I am happy to come across your site to share my experience. Thank you for giving me that opportunity.
